reviews.review:
Any excellent game to play on many levels. One of few co-op third person shooters where you and your friend are placed in a futuristic setting after a great war.  Tasked with having to rebalance the Sol system from heavy oppositions.  Using many forms of weaponry in the warrior way. A unique look and design of both the level, characters, and game play.  Digitial Extremes greatly focusing on evolving the game and continuing improving the game constantly. As they are also taking, using, heavily interacting with the gaming community to improve Warfarme. Unlike other developer, Digitial Extremes care about not only the product they are producing but the costumers that engage with said product.

I recommend this to anyone that likes to play solo or with friends.

If you liked the Mass Effect 3 multiplayer mode, this runs on a similar vein.

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

I wrote the above line back in April 2013, not all that long after the game entered "Beta", a state in which it remained for a long time.  That said, here we are 4+ years later, and this is still a game that I come back to.

It can get a bit grindy at times as you're hunting for components, but the devs have continually added content through free updates that in any other game would be a paid DLC/expansion.  

Additionaly, the plotline within the game has unfolded significantly since I started playing.  I took a 6-7 month break at one point and was blown away when I came back.

Overall, I definitely recommend this game, especially to play with friends.

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Update for 2019:  I still really love this game, and love that the devs continue to develop and grow it.  My only real issue at this point is that it seems more difficult for an entry level player to get into it.  IIRC, there's supposed to be a new player experience update coming with Empyrion, so I'm hopeful for that.

If you like cooperative games, this is one of the best ones. Third person shooter, coupled with good progression system, and lots of content, this is a fun game to play together. The game still gets updates in 2019, and more optimized than ever before, and the amount of content in it is truly outstanding.
need some friends to play with you at higher level instances. good co op shooter and free to grind.
